name: breathesafe
description: BreatheSafe - air quality you can act on, for anyone in India

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit -p .
scripts.build: cd infrastructure && sam build && cd ../frontend && npx next build
scripts.deploy:dev: cd infrastructure && sam build && sam deploy --config-env dev
scripts.deploy: cd infrastructure && sam build && sam deploy
